    conformeR

    Conformal clustering of gene differential expression.

    conformeR is a wrapper around the LEMUR R package that adds uncertainty quantification to LEMUR’s neighborhood on predicted differential expression, using conformal prediction, and without altering the underlying model.

    Installation

    conformeR is not yet on CRAN or Bioconductor. Install the development version directly from GitHub.

    install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("juslecl/conformeR", build_vignettes = TRUE)

    Usage 

    library(conformeR)

    See ?conformeR for the main entry point.

    Vignette

    Open it with:

    browseVignettes("conformeR")

    or, from the R console:

    vignette("conformeR")
